A place for derivations, calculations, numerical methods, and ideas that benefit from a little more space. Notes can be short references or longer explorations; each one states its assumptions and conventions.

The first note connects Dicke collective decay to continuous-time Markov chains, from transition rates and waiting times to trajectory sampling.
